title: Iterative map with power-law scaling of Gamma-distributed fluctuations related to prime numbers
summary: Prime numbers arise in several contexts beyond number theory, including statistical mechanics, quantum mechanics, and dynamical systems. However, the mechanisms underlying the irregularities of their sequence and their connections to physical systems remain poorly understood. The present work provides further insight into the search for deterministic fingerprints in the prime sequence. To this end, prime gaps at different separation distances are investigated through an empirical analysis.
